title: Closed-loop real-frequency acquisition with common final Loewner/VF fitter
selection_rule: Choose candidate with smaller geometric mean heldout NRMSE over positive-noise development cases; retain both development outcomes; no selection/tuning using confirmation

budget.heldout_grid: 1024 clean points disjoint from acquisition lattice

noise_table: One frozen noise realization per system/candidate, shared by every strategy; colored scenario AR1 .95 along log-frequency lattice; same standardized noise scales across levels
baselines: common pilot plus47 linear-coverage queries snapped uniquely to pool
common pilot plus47 random pool queries
closed-loop predicted-magnitude exploitation plus one exploration point per4-query batch
adaptive: Each4-query batch refits from observed data only; three I-optimal pole/residue sensitivity or model-disagreement queries plus one maximum log-gap exploration query; design fit failure falls back to coverage and is recorded
fitter: Identical ordinary projected Loewner plus eight stable-pole vector-fitting iterations for every final strategy, known true chain McMillan order; model mismatch excludes extra oscillator order
input_isolation: Acquisition gets public pool frequencies, noisy query callback, order, band; never scenario, noise level, true poles/residues/masses, clean responses or heldout grid. No oracle frequencies or repeats. Conjugates are inferred symmetry, not extra observations
primary: Dev-selected adaptive strategy / log_uniform geometric mean clean heldout NRMSE across all positive-noise confirmation cases
uncertainty: 5000 paired bootstrap resamples of50 independent system clusters with shared noise levels retained, fixed seed771931
limits: Synthetic input isolation and local hash freeze, not external preregistration, measured hardware or unknown-order discovery; approximate Fisher covariance is design heuristic not confidence interval; mismatch oscillator numerator coefficient.025 not norm percentage
